about: The Surfaces level's cases over a runtime's HTTP API, in the shape Spade's speaks (`/v1/conversations/{id}/panels`, `/v1/panels/pages/{hash}`, `/panels/{surface}/actions`). Each case installs the base manifest with `with` merged over it, its `pages` beside it, then takes its steps: `page` (fetch the panel's page as a client would) and `act {action, value?, confirmed?}` (an action as the panel's page sends it, or as the person confirmed it outside the page). `expect`: `served_as_text` (the page comes back as text that can't run as a page of its own), `refused` (the action never reaches the bot), `taken` (it does). Scenario cases run through the scenario door as the runtime part's do, with `cards`: each card title the run showed. `id` names the case in reports and never changes.

base.name: Flight watcher
base.task: You watch flight fares for the person.

effects.why: Drafts a mail to your travel agent. You send it.

cases.name: a card the bot shows is drawn from its data
